synthetic_inferences.sql: SELECT nombre, ciudad FROM clientes ORDER BY nombre;
SELECT m.`nombre` FROM clientes AS m LEFT JOIN pedidos AS e ON e.cliente_id = m.id WHERE e.`id` IS NULL ORDER BY m.`nombre`;

SELECT m.`nombre`, ROUND(SUM(e.total), 2) AS total FROM clientes AS m JOIN pedidos AS e ON e.cliente_id = m.id WHERE e.`estado` = 'completado' AND e.`fecha` >= '2024-01-01' AND e.`fecha` <= '2024-12-31' GROUP BY m.`id`, m.`nombre` ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 1;
